text:
Predicates:
HasVisa(x, y) ::: x has a visa type y.
ApplyFor(x, y, z) ::: x needs to apply for z if x wants to work in y.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ HasVisa(x, F1) ∨ HasVisa(x, J1)) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ HasVisa(x, F1)) → ApplyFor(x, US, CPT) ∨ ApplyFor(x, US, OPT)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
Student(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
ApplyFor(mike, US, CPT) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
HasVisa(mike, J1) ::: Mike has a J1 visa.
